home.tagline: A cross-platform MUD client. Connect to one of your saved worlds below, or open the MUD List to find a game.
home.privacy: Your worlds and passwords stay on this device.
home.noWorlds: No saved worlds yet. Open the MUD List, or add one.
dock.floatTab: Float this tab into its own window
map.nameArea: Name the area you're standing in
gmcp.pathWarn: Not in the GMCP arriving right now. Fine for a field that appears elsewhere (e.g. a ship field while planet-side), but it may also be a typo — it shows nothing until it resolves.
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Global defaults for the whole app. A world can override its colours in its own profile.
settings.keepCommand: Keep the last command in the box after sending (press Enter to resend)
settings.noAutoDock: Floating windows don't auto-dock when dragged (use the panel's dock button to re-dock)
settings.scrollbackHint: The soft cap. History grows to 5x this while you scroll up so nothing is trimmed under you.
settings.coloursHint: Remaps the 16 standard colours a MUD indexes into. Best effort: a server that sends exact (truecolour) shades shows those as-is. A world can override this palette in its profile.
